answer: Identity is earned by transcribing one yarrow plot: fifty scanned pages of the public Fable archive, handwritten declarations that commodity OCR cannot read. The copy goes on the crystal ledger, open for anyone to check against the scans; a randomly drawn second applicant transcribes the same plot blind, and only pages where both copies agree count, mismatches go to a third hand. Every plot holds different pages, so no transcription serves two puppets. Forging 1,000 puppets costs 1,000 x 50 pages, about 3,000 hours of copying; an honest agent pays one three-hour plot.
